plugins.name: plan
plugins.description: A Swarm of role-based skills (product-owner, architect, engineer, simplifier, auditor) plus adversarial spec/plan/implementation validators that drive a feature, bug fix, or refactor through a gated spec → plan → execute → audit → commit lifecycle.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: A web research specialist agent and skill that resolve questions against live external sources using two independent search paths — Gemini Flash on Vertex AI with Google Search grounding, plus native web search — then cross-check them and report verified facts separately from unverified assertions. Standalone: requires gcloud ADC, and the other plugins do not depend on it.
